$comment: Data for docs/design/dungeon.md (mw-e26.1), cross-checked against connectivity.json, the puzzle and fact registries and the route matrix by src/content/dungeon.test.ts. Ids are connectivity node/edge ids.

areas.note: Signposted road from Market Green to the gate (mw-e25.23).
Boarded gate; six ways in (route matrix mine-gate). Wolves let sleepwalkers pass; the gate is the first obstacle.
First interior space; the winch cage, the Bell Line rule, a safe room to learn the Deepworks' look.
Square pillared halls; goblin patrols, Tallow Ooze in the half-cut blocks. The first real fight.
Goblin camp in the old cutting hall: parley is the default, fighting or sneaking is the player's choice (bible 4.1 beat 6). Quiet by design; a hostile camp makes it heavy for that save.
Newer silver workings: Hollow patrols, mimics in the ore carts, loom-silk webs creeping in from the breach side.
Vane's ledger, the horn-ring, the breach; a hushed lore room.
The hole into the Knot; the dread beat before the Outer Ring.
Flooded gallery where the Weeping Adit enters; the Frozen Channel puzzle. A way past the goblin camp, never required.
Goblin lookout below, the long way in.
Hollow Sentinels above; the keeper's log and signal mirror.
The collapsed tunnel into the upper mine (long way in, any class).
The river way in; swim, raft or barge.
Head of the priory road; where the forest, the ridge path and the town road meet. PROPOSAL (bible silent).
Roofless nave; the priory hub. Dormant Forgotten stir only if the bell is rung sour.
Singing-monk statues; the Watchers puzzle opens the hidden choir door.
Surviving pages and book mimics; the pact, the Sounding Shaft and the abbot's letters (bible 4.1 beat 9).
Dead pear tree; Clatter's memory made visible. Dead end by design.
Stair down to the sealed crypt; the Sunbeam puzzle.
Sealed from this side until the Knot-side seal is broken (bible 4.1 beat 9, 4.2 Befriend).
Old cistern: Glen Well ladder-rung and jail drain meet here, then up to the nave.
The cracked Vesper Bell and the top of the Sounding Shaft; the Vespers ending beat.
Hornfolk runes, loom spiders, the first Forgotten; the Scales puzzle gates the Hornfolk gate.
The Forgotten and Clatter; the Dark Crossing pit. Clatter fights or does not, depending on the hymn.
Sound misbehaves; the Chimes puzzle and the portcullis trap. A trap and a puzzle, not a brawl.
Brother Horn, outside the Fold (bible 4.2). Fight, trick, befriend or help.
Sealed vault of sleepers; the wake-up point. A dead end by design.
Foot of the shaft; the Climb. Held by Horn, goblins or Clatter, otherwise a chase (bible 4.1 beat 13).
The abbot and the Hushlings; the dream leaks into the world.

puzzles.name: Sunbeam
puzzles.role: Light the sensor so the stair's sealed carving can be read; reward is lore, the way through the crypt stays sealed (PROPOSAL, open question 3).

puzzles.name: Frozen Channel
puzzles.role: Weigh the far pad across the flooded channel (Frostglass, rope or raft); guards the cache behind the river entry (PROPOSAL).

puzzles.name: Scales
puzzles.role: Balance the two plates to open the Hornfolk gate (route matrix outer-ring-gate).

puzzles.name: Watchers
puzzles.role: Turn the singing-monk statues to face the altar; opens the hidden choir door to the scriptorium (edge choir-scriptorium, fact watchers.solved).

puzzles.name: Dark Crossing
puzzles.role: Reach the far pad across the Ossuary pit in the dark, or hum the hymn and let Clatter guide you (route matrix ossuary-crossing).

puzzles.name: Chimes
puzzles.role: Ring the bells in the order heard to settle the echoes and raise the portcullis (route matrix chapel-of-echoes).

macroRoutes.name: Through the front gate
macroRoutes.note: Vane's key, the padlock or vent chimney, the side-boarding, the winch pulley or the inner bar (route matrix mine entries 1 to 4). The spine of the critical path.

macroRoutes.name: The long way, by Mooring's Watch
macroRoutes.note: Through the Briarwood and the watchtower, the supply-tunnel collapse, and out into the old galleries (bible 4.1 beat 5). Skips the gate, the winch house and the front-gate obstacle.

macroRoutes.name: Up the river
macroRoutes.note: Up the flooded Weeping Adit into the lower Deepworks and on to the silver galleries. Skips the winch house, old galleries and the goblin camp.

macroRoutes.name: Down the Sounding Shaft
macroRoutes.note: Through the forest to the priory, up to the belfry and down the shaft to its foot, a door from the Cradle. The bible's loop 'the priory crypt and the Sounding Shaft join the labyrinth' (3.1) makes this walkable; whether it is open before Act III is open question 1. Skips the whole Deepworks and the Knot's outer halls.

macroRoutes.name: The ridge path to the priory
macroRoutes.note: Mooring's Watch's ridge path (moorings-priory-ridge) to the priory road, then the shaft. Closes the forest-watchtower-priory loop (bible 3.1).

macroRoutes.name: Through the crypt
macroRoutes.note: The crypt shortcut: sealed from the priory side until the Knot-side seal is broken (befriending Horn opens it, bible 4.2). A return route, not a way in.

macroRoutes.name: By the Glen Well and the cistern
macroRoutes.note: The loose ladder-rung into the cistern and up into the nave (bible 3.1, 3.5), then the same shaft descent as priory-shaft. Every class climbs the rung; the jail drain is the other way into the cistern.

knight.how: Barge the rotten cribbing at the collapse.
Climb down the Glen Well rung into the cistern.

archer.how: Shoot the winch pulley so the cage drops.
Anchor a rope across the flooded run.
Shoot a rope line up the shaft to skip half the climb.

sorcerer.how: Burn the cribbing that holds the fall.
Haul the counterweight chains into a stair.
Frostglass the current's edge (needs spell.frostglass, mw-e08).

thief.how: Pick the padlock or climb the vent chimney.
Squeeze up the cracked wall over the fall.
Traverse the adit wall above the waterline.

criticalPath.note: Wolves, the barred gate and the choice of six ways in.
Breathing room; mechanisms, the Bell Line rule.
First real fight: goblin patrols and Tallow Ooze.
Parley by default; talking reveals what the goblins have seen.
Ledger and horn-ring; the Knot's dread builds.
The threshold; first sight of the Knot.
First Forgotten and loom spiders; the Scales gate.
Clatter and the Dark Crossing; fighting is optional if you hum the hymn.
The Chimes puzzle and the portcullis trap; no brawl.
The reveal: the sleepers on moss beds.
Revisit: Horn resolved, the abbot's voice, Tansy rises.
The Climb: held, or a chase, but a traversal set piece rather than a brawl.
Vespers: hang the tongue and ring the bell.

shortcuts.opens: Mooring's Watch supply tunnel into the old galleries (long way in, skips gate and winch house).
River mouth into the lower Deepworks (skips the gate, galleries and goblin camp).
Cutting hall down to the quay: a fast way out of the Deepworks (one-way).
The Sleepers' Path to the mine gate by a tracker's secret.
Town to the priory by the Glen Well rung, cistern and nave.
The jail cell to the cistern and the priory (failure creates stories).
Priory nave to the crypt, once the seal is broken (same fact as ossuary-crypt).
Ossuary Galleries to the priory crypt: Horn's befriend reward and the way out of the Knot.
Belfry to the Sounding Shaft's foot: the Climb up, or the shaft descent down (open question 1).
The hidden choir door to the scriptorium, opened by the Watchers puzzle.

respawn.note: Bible 4.5: you wake in the Fold on a moss bed, a bandage you did not tie. Each rescue counts in horn.rescues.
Bible 4.5: the goblin camp; Kettleback charges a carrying fee in coin or trinkets.
Bible 4.5: among the Forgotten, who have laid you out like a monk for burial.
Bible silent. Proposal: goblins carry you to their camp (same carrying fee), else the last save.
Bible silent. Proposal: as the Briarwood, you wake at the Sleeping Ox and Juniper says where she found you (bible 4.5).

levelVariants.change: The town brings bread to the gate; Horn's lantern burns in the winch house window.
The bell rings each dusk; the goblins, Hale or Tansy pull the rope (an NPC at the rope).
Sealed: the collapsed tunnel is frozen and shored, or walled by goblins; the song never reaches the town again.
The Fold is empty and swept; Horn keeps the moss beds.
Clatter walks the halls humming, apologising less.
A recast clapper hangs where the old tongue was (Oswin's recast, bible 5.7): the bell rings true.
Empty: no Warden; Horn's horn on its hook (the item the player carries).
The clan takes up the watch in its own way.
Clatter walks the halls humming; or no one does.
The last slide: a lantern at the gate and a child's footprints going in.
The bell is rung; the sleepers go home and the bounty is paid.
Left open: Vane's tunnel keeps running silver and Hornfolk gold from below the Line.
The gate stands open and busy; the mine prospers.
The bell is rung, mostly; the rope is worn thin.
Ledger buried: the strongbox is empty.
The player wakes here years later; the abbot is gone and a goblin pokes them with a stick.
The bell stays silent; the tongue is gone or never hung.
Nobody comes to the gate; the town is asleep.

epilogueOnly.effect: Adds slides; never changes the headline ending (bible 4.4).
The name-stone goes home to the Knot (adds a slide in Horn's Hall).
Last slide: a man in a far city finds a tiny ox asleep on every coin (post-MVP hook).

setPieces.name: The sour bell
setPieces.note: Ringing the cracked bell without its tongue (hammer, mace, arrow, Thunderclap) wakes every Forgotten in the priory and draws Hushlings up the shaft; Horn hears it and comes to you (bible 4.5).

setPieces.name: Horn's Hall
setPieces.note: The Warden encounter, outside the Fold; every resolution of 4.2 starts here.

setPieces.name: The Cradle
setPieces.note: Round chamber where the dream leaks into the physical; the abbot conducts.

setPieces.name: The Climb
setPieces.note: Vertical ascent up the shaft with the song rising behind (bible 4.1 beat 13).

setPieces.name: Vespers
setPieces.note: Hang the tongue and ring the bell; the song falters and the sleepers wake (bible 4.1 beat 14).
